g.text: Summary: what aparta is going to do
agents (Claude Code, Gemini CLI): inject GH_CONFIG_DIR, CLOUDSDK_ACTIVE_CONFIG_NAME,
git: create ~/.gitconfig-personal (email ana.dev@gmail.com) and add an includeIf for
agents (Claude Code, Gemini CLI): inject GH_CONFIG_DIR into the repos of ~/personal
Every write to an existing file creates a backup (.bak-aparta-<timestamp>) and merges, nothing
is overwritten. Use --dry-run to only see the diff.
